coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Radiance
record.summary: Radiance is a Bosa Development condominium building of about 99 homes (DBI's permit says 98) at 325 China Basin Street, the first of Bosa's three Mission Bay condominium projects; DBI's new-construction permit for a nine-story building was filed in May 2005 and recorded complete in January 2010, the Assessor gives 2008 as the year built, and the San Francisco Chronicle (via SFGate) reported the homes on offer in March 2009.

notes.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint(s), not a hand trace or plan estimate. The underlying Assessor parcel is condo-mapped across many individually owned per-unit lots (confirmed against DataSF's Assessor parcel data), so no single blklot represents the whole building and it cannot be matched to a single parcel record the way a single-owner parcel can. Using the real building footprint from OSM instead of a fabricated or arbitrarily chosen 'representative' unit lot, the same real-geometry-without-a-single-parcel pattern already used for several Pier 70 buildings (DataSF Building Footprints) and for Mission Bay's own real park polygons.

changes.text: Added a sourced dossier for Radiance.

The map notes said Radiance is 9 stories per two realtor sources; of the readable sources, SFGate describes a nine-story and a six-story building and OSM has 8 levels, so the notes were rewritten. The 'first homes' milestone moved from September 2008 to March 2009, the date of the SFGate article that reports it, and the December 2006 groundbreaking milestone was removed because no readable source dates it. The OSM tag citation was corrected to name=.

open_questions: No primary opening date: the Assessor's 2008 is a year; DBI's permit sign-off is 2010-01-19; the Chronicle article of March 22, 2009 is the earliest dated report read.

Phase question: SocketSite (July 2010) called a 318-unit 'Radiance West' the 'Phase Two' at 325 China Basin, while Bosa's own page names the later 16-storey towers 'Madrone' and DBI's 16-story, 319-unit permit is at 435 China Basin (completed 2014-11-12). This dossier covers only the 99-unit building; whether the map's footprint includes any of that later phase is not established by anything read.
Architect not confirmed from a source read (a brokerage page naming one could not be opened).
Unit count 98 (DBI) versus 99 (press, architecture database, Assessor parcel count).
Bosa's own page lists 'Status Active 2005 - 2015' for all three Mission Bay buildings together and '693' units; it gives no Radiance-specific date or unit count.
No OCII design-review or commission item for the block was located.
